name: tzayad
description: Equipment sign-out system, end-to-end encrypted. Cloudflare Pages + Functions + D1.

scripts.deploy: npm test && wrangler pages deploy public
scripts.db:migrate:local: for f in migrations/*.sql; do npx wrangler d1 execute tzayad --local --file="$f" || true; done
scripts.db:migrate:remote: for f in migrations/*.sql; do npx wrangler d1 execute tzayad --remote --file="$f" || true; done
